annotations.title: Get typical asking price per m²

description: Use this when the user asks how much homes cost per square metre in a Czech town or city part, or whether a price per m² is reasonable. Returns the median ASKING price per m² of the municipality (monthly for rent) from LivinIsto's monthly index, with the sample size and month; with a layout (2+kk, 3+1…) also the median of today's comparable listings. No median below 8 listings. These are prices sellers ask, not sale prices; location, condition and floor move the price, so present it as a guide. No figure means found: false — an unknown place (location null) or a known place with too few listings (location set) — never a national figure. Do not use it to value a specific property's condition, for commercial property or for places outside the Czech Republic.

location.description: Municipality or city part in Czech, e.g. Brno, Kolín, Praha 5, Smíchov.

propertyType.description: byt (flat, default), dum (house), chata (cottage), pozemek (building plot), apartman.

transaction.description: prodej (sale, default) or pronajem (rent; figures are monthly).

name: get_price_per_m2

comparedWith.description: Which group of today's offer: cityRoomsLayout = same layout in the municipality, cityRooms = same number of rooms, cityPart = the city part, city/citySize = whole municipality, district/districtSize = whole district.

byLayout.description: Only with layout: median of today's comparable listings.

found.description: false = no figure: either LivinIsto does not know the place (location is null) or it has too few comparable offers there (location is set; the note says so). Never a national median.

location.description: The place as LivinIsto understood it (municipality, or a part of Prague/Brno…).

medianCzkPerM2.description: Median ASKING price per m² (per month for rent) in the latest month of the municipality index; null when fewer than 8 listings.

monthComplete.description: false = the current month, still filling up.

municipality.description: The municipality the index covers. For a part of a city it is the WHOLE city — say so.

sampleSize.description: Listings the median is computed from.

title: Get typical asking price per m²
